svg.title: Bachelor's awards by language
svg.desc: Distinct educational indicators, not border crossings or a count of all learners. Exact observations and provenance accompany this figure.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Nationwide IPEDS | Chinese, Japanese and Korean | academic year ending
NCES IPEDS; 50 states/DC, Title IV degree-granting institutions. Chinese 16.0301, Japanese 16.0302, Korean
16.0303; language/literature first-major awards from 2001. Not enrollment or unique people. 2025 is
provisional. The 2000 major-coding boundary breaks the lines.
